During [[Operation Shadow Hand]], an '''Imperial shipyard''' located in the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]] was [[Siege of an Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard|besieged]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces. [[Troop transport/Legends|Troopship]] ''[[Pelagia]]'' was en route to reinforce the siege, before it was [[Destruction of the Pelagia|destroyed]] in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] by the [[particle disintegrator warhead]] fired from the [[Galaxy Gun]].<ref name="Empire's End 1" />
